'''Terrelia''' was a celestial body located in the [[Terrelia system/Legends|Terrelia system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Terrelian Jango Jumper/Legends|Terrelian Jango Jumper]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Thief/Legends|thief]]<ref name="SWE">{{SWE|characters|cassiecryar|Cassie Cryar}}</ref> [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Terrelia was mentioned in the [[2010]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' by [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Terrelia [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body, in grid square L-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
